description: Build the song-planner FULL PACKAGE: canonical planning methodology, thin agent, SOP 09, the SONG BRIEF artifact template, and one sample brief. This formalizes what is currently SOP 01 'PHASE 1: Analysis (Steps 1-9)' into a reviewable, approvable deliverable produced BEFORE any lyrics. GUIDED MODE is the default posture (suggest a methodology-backed default per decision -> user confirms/overrides -> next). Independent of FEAT-003 (docs) but FEAT-002 (guided writer seam) depends on this feature's brief spec/location conventions.
steps: Create core/methodology/song-planning.md as a CANONICAL methodology file following the pattern of core/methodology/songwriting.md (# The Song Planning Method, a '> CANONICAL METHODOLOGY' blockquote, the Three-Tier Evidence Labeling table copied verbatim from songwriting.md, then content, then a References section). This file ELEVATES SOP 01 Phase 1 Steps 1-9 (thesis, semantic, emotional, prosodic planning, narrative arc + the Turn, voice/accent, genre 70/30, arrangement/dynamics sketch, key/BPM/time-sig, production/commercial) as the authoritative planning source. CRITICAL: do NOT duplicate craft DEFINITIONS. For prosody thresholds, hook timing, V2-new-info, bridge-turn, Fabbri 5 rules, 70/30 rule, key-emotion mapping, BPM-emotion, Hit Formula F1/F2 — REFERENCE where they live: 'see core/methodology/songwriting.md Step N' and 'see SONGWRITING_KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md section X' and 'references/SUNO_STYLE_GENRE_REFERENCE.md'. The file describes the PLANNING PROCEDURE and DELIVERABLE, pulling craft logic by reference. Include a section that enumerates the decision frameworks the plan draws on (Genre-Emotion Alignment, Key Selection, BPM-Emotion, Hit Formula F1/F2) as pointers, not restatements.

In song-planning.md, define the SONG BRIEF artifact spec/template with these 12 sections IN THIS ORDER: (1) Song Thesis (one sentence), (2) Semantic analysis, (3) Emotional analysis with start->through->arrive journey + BRECVEMA mechanisms, (4) Narrative arc + where the Turn is / what the bridge reveals, (5) Voice/accent (register, dialect, emotional state start vs end), (6) Genre mapping (70/30 split, Fabbri check, instrument palette), (7) Key + BPM + time signature with reasoning, (8) Arrangement/dynamics sketch (growth pattern, negative space, hook placement), (9) Structure map (section sequence) + V6 mode label (Default/Roots vs MODE C Cinematic/Theatrical/Concept — cite references/V6_TAG_DISCOVERY.md), (10) Hook approach (type + candidate hook line), (11) Production/commercial (target audience, length, platform, solo/duet, standalone/album), (12) Open questions/decisions for the user. State explicitly that the brief is CONCEPTUAL and does NOT write verses.

In song-planning.md, document the GUIDED MODE loop as the DEFAULT: step through EACH brief decision, present a methodology-backed SUGGESTED DEFAULT for each, and PROMPT the user to confirm or override before moving on. Document that AUTO-PILOT mode still exists (triggers: 'surprise me', 'you choose', 'just go', etc.) but guided prompting is primary. Document the Candidate Style Prompt behavior: the planner emits one as a FLEXIBLE TEMPLATE that prompts for EACH value (genre + 70/30 split, BPM, key, vocal identity/range, production feel, mood, exclusions), showing a suggested default per value the user confirms/overrides — output is a filled-but-editable style template, NOT a locked string. Document the album-vs-standalone prompt (only run a LIGHT album continuity pre-check IF user says album: key fits harmonic map, palette differs from neighbors; then prompt for blueprint/adjacent tracks; point to the album-continuity agent for the full check). Document the stop-at-brief-vs-flow-into-writing prompt.

Create .kiro/agents/song-planner.md as a THIN agent following the frontmatter+behavioral+includes pattern of .kiro/agents/songwriter.md and builder.md. Frontmatter: name: song-planner; description prose that lists trigger phrases 'plan a song', 'song brief', 'outline a track', 'help me plan', 'plan out a song', 'brief for'; tools: ["read", "write", "web"]. Body: # Song Planner Agent, ## Behavioral Directives describing GUIDED MODE as default (suggest default -> prompt confirm/override -> next) + the album/stop-vs-flow/style-template prompts + that the brief is conceptual (no verses) + that it saves the brief with the eventual song as SONGNAME.brief.md, ## Creative Tenets with #[[file:core/tenets.md]], ## Methodology with #[[file:core/methodology/song-planning.md]], and reference includes to #[[file:core/methodology/songwriting.md]] and #[[file:core/methodology/critique.md]] so craft logic loads from source (NOT restated in the agent). Agent must contain NO craft rule definitions.

Create .kiro/sops/09-planning-a-song.md following the SOP pattern (see .kiro/sops/01 and 07): # SOP 09: Planning a Song, a '> Note' blockquote stating the canonical methodology lives in core/methodology/song-planning.md, ## Prerequisites, ## Procedure as a step-by-step GUIDED planning walkthrough that produces the SONG BRIEF (walk each of the 12 brief sections as a suggest-default-then-confirm step), the SONG BRIEF OUTPUT TEMPLATE (a fillable markdown skeleton of the 12 sections), the brief FILE LOCATION convention (save WITH the eventual song, same folder, naming pattern SONGNAME.brief.md — e.g. under songs/ or examples/songs/...), ## Output, ## Time Estimate. Reference craft checks rather than restating them.

Create ONE sample brief following the pattern so the format is concrete. Place it alongside songs at examples/songs/standalones/ using the naming convention (e.g. examples/songs/standalones/Three_In_The_Morning.brief.md, matching the existing Three_In_The_Morning.md song). Fill all 12 sections with concrete conceptual content consistent with that song's concept; do NOT write verses. This demonstrates the SONGNAME.brief.md convention lives next to the song file.
acceptance_criteria: core/methodology/song-planning.md exists, is marked CANONICAL, contains the 12-section SONG BRIEF spec in the exact order, documents GUIDED MODE as default + auto-pilot + flexible style-template + album/stop-vs-flow prompts, and REFERENCES (does not redefine) songwriting.md/critique.md/SONGWRITING_KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md/SUNO_STYLE_GENRE_REFERENCE.md for all craft definitions and decision frameworks.

.kiro/agents/song-planner.md exists as a thin agent with correct frontmatter (name, description with the six trigger phrases, tools) and #[[file:]] includes for core/tenets.md, core/methodology/song-planning.md, core/methodology/songwriting.md, core/methodology/critique.md; contains no craft rule definitions.
.kiro/sops/09-planning-a-song.md exists with the guided procedure, the fillable SONG BRIEF template, and the SONGNAME.brief.md location convention documented.
A sample brief file exists at examples/songs/standalones/ named per the SONGNAME.brief.md convention, filled with all 12 conceptual sections and containing no verse lyrics.
grep confirms every #[[file:...]] path in song-planner.md resolves to an existing file.
verification: Confirm files exist: core/methodology/song-planning.md, .kiro/agents/song-planner.md, .kiro/sops/09-planning-a-song.md, and the sample .brief.md.
grep the #[[file:...]] includes in .kiro/agents/song-planner.md and confirm each path exists on disk.

grep song-planning.md for references to core/methodology/songwriting.md and core/methodology/critique.md to confirm craft logic is pulled by reference, and scan for any REDEFINITION of the 12 categories / prosody thresholds / 70/30 rule / hook timing (there should be none — only references).
Read the sample brief and confirm it contains the 12 sections in order and no verse lyrics.
findings: Built the full song-planner package. Created core/methodology/song-planning.md as a CANONICAL methodology file (CANONICAL blockquote, Three-Tier Evidence table copied verbatim from songwriting.md, 12-section SONG BRIEF spec in exact order, GUIDED MODE default loop + AUTO-PILOT + flexible Candidate Style Prompt template + album-vs-standalone light pre-check + stop-vs-flow prompt + brief location convention). All craft rules (prosody 7-12, hook timing 5-30s, V2-new-info, bridge turn, Fabbri 5 rules, 70/30, key-emotion, BPM-emotion, Hit Formula F1/F2, V6 mode label, 12-category rubric) are pulled BY REFERENCE only -- no redefinitions -- citing core/methodology/songwriting.md (with step numbers), core/methodology/critique.md, SONGWRITING_KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md, references/SUNO_STYLE_GENRE_REFERENCE.md, and references/V6_TAG_DISCOVERY.md. Created .kiro/agents/song-planner.md as a thin agent (tools ['read','write','web'], six trigger phrases, includes for core/tenets.md + song-planning.md + songwriting.md + critique.md, no craft logic). Created .kiro/sops/09-planning-a-song.md with the guided 12-step walkthrough, fillable brief template, and SONGNAME.brief.md location convention. Created sample brief at examples/songs/standalones/Three_In_The_Morning.brief.md (all 12 conceptual sections, consistent with the existing song, no verse lyrics). Verified all four #[[file:]] includes resolve on disk. No build/test suite exists (Markdown-only project); verification was structural. Did NOT touch README/CHANGELOG/WORKFLOW_DIAGRAM (those belong to FEAT-003 per task plan).
